components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lime-filled, pill-shaped action for the main operation in a view.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); font:600 14px/1.25 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 90%,transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet, text-led action used for secondary controls.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:8px 14px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); font:500 14px/1.25 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Shared evidence container with translucent green glass and a subtle lift.
components.html:
Traffic over time

Request volume by local verdict
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px; padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:24px; background:var(--card); color:var(--card-foreground); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%); backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(140%); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06),0 10px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-card h3 { margin:0; font:600 16px/1.25 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--muted-foreground); font:400 14px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; }

components.name: Outline Badge
components.description: Compact labeled verdict or action marker; preserve text alongside any color cue.
components.css: .ds-badge-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; width:max-content; padding:2px 10px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:999px; color:var(--foreground); font:500 12px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-badge-outline i { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--series-uncertain); }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Selected destination in desktop navigation or the compact mobile dock.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:6px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:999px; background:var(--card); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px); backdrop-filter:blur(24px); } .ds-nav button { height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; font:500 14px/1.25 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease,color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-active { background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); font-weight:600!important; } .ds-nav-idle { background:transparent; color:var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-nav-idle:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:var(--foreground); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Source Select
components.description: Native source filter in Investigations, with a compact glass treatment.
components.css: .ds-select-label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:var(--muted-foreground); font:400 14px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-select { padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid var(--input); border-radius:14px; background:var(--card); color:var(--foreground); font:500 14px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-select:hover { background:var(--accent); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.northStar: “Evidence at a glance” — focused triage with honest operating context.
narrative.overview:
The interface feels focused, assured, and precise. A deep forest backdrop and layered green glass give the evidence room to breathe, while compact labels, tabular counts, and monospace identifiers keep dense operational details scannable. Signal lime marks selection and primary action; verdict and status colors retain their distinct meanings.

The dashboard preserves its existing navigation while adding views in the same visual world. The overview puts operating context and a prioritized, clickable attention queue first, followed by traffic trend, known-human honesty metrics and latest activity.
keyCharacteristics: Dark forest-green surfaces with translucent glass layers.
A restrained lime signal for active and primary states.
Dense evidence rows with calm hierarchy and soft corners.

rules.name: The Signal Lime Rule
rules.body: Keep lime for interaction and selection; do not reuse it as a traffic data series.

rules.name: The Verdict Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Preserve distinct chart and status colors, and pair status meaning with text or an icon rather than color alone.

dos: Do keep lime on interaction and selection, and keep data series mapped to their distinct chart colors.
Do use the system sans for interface copy and monospace for identifiers and compact time metadata.
Do pair status colors with visible words or icons and preserve the uncertain grey treatment.
Do use layered green glass for shared surfaces and reserve shadows for actual separation or lift.
Do preserve the incumbent dashboard shell and view language when adding a new view.
donts: Don't turn evidence into a generic AI-looking dashboard of interchangeable metric tiles.
Don't imply that detector recommendations are live enforcement; the dashboard labels them as recommendations.
Don't use color as the only carrier of verdict or status meaning.
